summary.about: Examines how post-Brexit UK trade agreements may redirect trade away from Commonwealth developing economies.
summary.audience: UK and Commonwealth trade officials, exporters and development agencies.
summary.method: Uses a multi-sector GTAP model to simulate several UK trade-agreement scenarios. Counterfactual outcomes are evaluated against a calibrated baseline through sectoral output, trade, factor-income, and welfare channels.
summary.insights: New agreements with efficient developed partners may erode market access for less-developed Commonwealth exporters. These are scenario-conditioned comparative responses rather than unconditional forecasts.
